_about: Hand checks for the old-code baseline on the held-out set. Old code (PR #31 merge cc30707, v1 prompts and context) on the same 12 incidents, fixtures reduced to schema 1 and retrieval re-run against the v1 runbooks. Reports in ml/reports/llm_eval/heldout_before/. Same rubric as hand_checks.json; written by reading each diagnosis, not by the matcher or a model.

ho_cm_key_first.note: ConfigMap exists but lacks key RATE_LIMIT -> correct; regex has no 'does not contain'.

ho_cpu_limit_rollout.note: Blames an idle upstream input source; never mentions the 15m CPU limit or throttling (the old context has no limits/usage).

ho_img_quay_rollout.note: Blames DNS for failing to resolve quay.io; the evidence is a registry DNS failure (no registry egress on the box's kind node), same convention as the v1 image-pull cases.

ho_pod_kill_two.note: Follows the metric anomaly (rising memory); ignores the pod replacement.
